newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL-BARKLEY, OAKLEY SUSPENDED AND FINED FOR FIGHTING.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-BARKLEY, OAKLEY SUSPENDED AND FINED FOR FIGHTING.

text.p: Charles Barkley of the Houston Rockets and Charles Oakley of the New York Knicks were suspended and fined by the NBA on Monday for fighting in last Friday's preseason game between the teams.
Oakley was suspended two games and fined $10,000 and Barkley was suspended one game and fined $5,000 for throwing punches.
Barkley grabbed a rebound and was wrestled to the floor by Oakley with 2:54 left in the first quarter. Barkley took exception to the hard foul and both players were ejected for throwing punches.
Oakley will miss New York's opener Friday at Toronto and the home opener Sunday against Charlotte.
Barkley will miss Houston's opener Friday against Sacramento.
